WITH base AS (
  SELECT app_id, TRIM(uid) AS uid,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_page_key), '')) AS page_key
  FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r
  WHERE dt = '2026-11-23'
    AND uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(uid) <> ''
), base_f AS (
  SELECT * FROM base
  WHERE page_key IS NOT NULL AND page_key <> '' AND length(page_key) <= 64
    AND NOT (
      TRIM(uid) IN ('null','NULL','Null','undefined','none','None','nil','me','guest','test','unknown','UNKNOWN','N/A','n/a','(null)','-','0','1','-1','')
      OR TRIM(uid) RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
      OR LOWER(TRIM(uid)) RLIKE '^(test|demo|dev|sample|fake|dummy)[_-]'
      OR TRIM(uid) RLIKE '^__GUEST__'
    )
), new_side AS (
  SELECT app_id, page_key, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS uid_n
  FROM base_f
  GROUP BY app_id, page_key
), old_side AS (
  SELECT app_id, page_key, uid_cnt AS uid_old
  FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d
  WHERE dt = '2026-11-23'
), j AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN n.app_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_miss_new,
    CASE WHEN o.app_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_miss_old,
    CASE WHEN n.app_id IS NOT NULL AND o.app_id IS NOT NULL AND n.uid_n <> o.uid_old THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_diff
